name: Survive Disasters for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Survive Disasters for Brainrots!! 🌩️

[How to Play]
Run fast and grab Brainrots! 🏃
Avoid weather disasters when they come! 🌪️
Stay alive and collect many Brainrots!🌨️
Upgrade your Brainrots to earn MORE money!💸
Upgrade your plot to unlock more plots and place additional Brainrots! 🏗️
Rebirth to upgrade your SPEED & PLOT! 🔁

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like 👍 the game and join 👥 the group for A FREE LEGENDARY 🌟
